title: Kast and Milei Reaffirm Chilean Sovereignty Over the Strait of Magellan, Issue Joint Declaration
detail: President José Antonio Kast and Argentine President Javier Milei held a bilateral meeting in Santiago on September 3 following Kast's earlier visit to Magallanes, issuing a joint declaration that the legal regime of the Strait of Magellan is 'plenamente vigente y de carácter definitivo' under the 1881 Boundary Treaty and the 1984 Peace and Friendship Treaty — resolving the diplomatic dispute triggered by an Argentine Air Force general's remarks questioning Chilean sovereignty over the strait. Kast also called on the United Kingdom to resume dialogue over the Falklands/Malvinas, backing Argentina's claim, while Milei recognized Chilean sovereignty over the strait; the two governments additionally announced cooperation on mining integration, trade, energy, security and Antarctic policy. A Criteria poll published September 6 (fielded September 3–4) found the country split on Kast's decision not to press Milei to sign a document stating the strait 'corresponds exclusively to Chile' rather than being a 'shared space' — 43% disagreed with Kast's approach against 41% who supported it.

media.caption: Kast and Milei reaffirm Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan — September 3, 2026

title: Far-Right Foro Madrid Summit Opens in Santiago With Kast and Milei, Draws Protests
detail: The V Regional Encounter of Foro Madrid — a gathering of roughly 40 far-right leaders from 25 countries organized by Vox's Fundación Disenso — opened September 3–4 at the Centro de Eventos San Carlos de Apoquindo in Santiago, inaugurated by President Kast and Javier Milei under the slogan 'Una nueva era para Iberoamérica' and welcomed by Vox secretary-general Ignacio Garriga. The summit addressed security, the economy, international politics and 'defense of Western values,' closing with a 'Declaración de Santiago de Chile' meant to set a cooperation roadmap for participating right-wing forces; CIPER Chile documented that several Foro Madrid leaders and invitees have previously called to 'hunt' migrants, criminalize abortion and shoot pro-Palestinian activists. Student, feminist, union and left-wing organizations mobilized protests in Santiago and Valparaíso against the summit's opening, framing it alongside opposition to Kast's security reform.

media.caption: Foro Madrid opens in Santiago with Kast and Milei — September 2026

title: Cadem Poll: Kast's Approval Falls to 34%, Lowest Since Taking Office; 61% Disapprove
detail: Cadem's Plaza Pública poll, fielded September 2 among 1,002 respondents across all 16 regions and published September 3, found President Kast's approval down 4 points to 34% — his lowest level since March 2026 — with disapproval at 61%, also a term high. 63% of respondents said Chile is heading in the wrong direction (up 5 points), and 79% rated the economic situation bad or very bad after the Central Bank's July IMACEC contraction of 1.5%, its worst reading in three years. On household finances, only 10% said their family budget was sufficient with savings, 52% said it barely stretched to month's end, and 36% said it was not enough.

media.caption: Cadem poll: Kast's approval falls to 34%, lowest since taking office — September 3, 2026

title: Hundreds Protest Kast's Security Reform at Plaza Italia, Compare It to Pinochet-Era Powers
detail: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered at Plaza Italia in downtown Santiago on September 3, chanting that President Kast is 'just like Pinochet' over his constitutional security reform, which would let the president declare up to eight-month states of emergency — restricting movement, assembly and communications — without prior congressional authorization. Carabineros fired tear gas and used water cannon to disperse the crowd. A 22-year-old student protester told reporters Kast 'is giving himself powers that a president in a democracy shouldn't have.' The protest coincided with the opening of the Foro Madrid far-right summit in Santiago, which Kast co-hosted with Javier Milei.

media.caption: Demonstrators clash with police over Kast's security reform at Plaza Italia — September 3, 2026
